paite: Huan Mattan tapa Shephatiah leh Pashur tapa Gedaliah leh Shelemiah tapa Jukal leh Malkijah tapa Pashurte'n, mipi tengteng kiang ah Jeremiah in,
heading: Tuibem Sung Ah Jeremiah
english: Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah, heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,

paite: "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai khopi a om nilouhte zaw namsau, kial leh hipi in asi ding ua, Kaldaite kiang a kipia bel ahing ding uh, ahinna akihumbit ding a ahing ding," chi in.
english: Thus says Yahweh, He who remains in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence; but he who goes forth to the Chaldeans shall live, and his life shall be to him for a prey, and he shall live.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai khopi Babulon kumpipa sepaihhonte khut ah piak ahi ngei ding a, ala ding, chi a agen angaikhia uhi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it.

paite: Huchi in heutute'n kumpipa kiang ah, "Hiai mi hihlup hi hen, ka hon ngen uh; ama'n akiang ua hiai thute gen in hiai khopi a galkapmi omlaite leh mipi tengteng tha hat lousak in; hiai mi'n hiai mipite hoihna azong kei a, asiatna azong zaw,” achi uhi.
english: Then the princes said to the king, “Please let this man be put to death; because he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words to them: for this man doesn’t seek the welfare of this people, but the hurt.”

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in, "Ngai un, amah na khut ua om ahi; kumpipa'n na deih louh lam uh hihthei ahi sam a," achi hi.
english: Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand; for the king is not he who can do anything against you.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah api ua, ngakmi huangsung a om kumpipa tapa Malkijah tuibem ah apailut ua; Jeremiah bel khau in akhesuk ua, huai tuibem ah buannawi kia lou ngal tui a-om kei a; buannawi ah Jeremiah akia hi.
english: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. In the dungeon there was no water, but mire; and Jeremiah sank in the mire.

paite: Huan Ethiopia mi, michilgeh kumpipa' inn a om sek Ebed-melek in Jeremiah tuibem ah akoih uh chih ana za a; huchih lai in kumpipa bel Benjamin kongpi ah atu a;
heading: Ebed-melek In Jeremiah Ahunkhia
english: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, a eunuch, who was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon (the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin),

paite: Ebed-melek bel kumpipa' inn a kipan apawt a, kumpipa kiang ah,
english: Ebedmelech went forth out of the king’s house, and spoke to the king, saying,

paite: "Ka pu, kumpipa, hiai mite'n zawlnei Jeremiah tuibem a ana paihkhiak uh thil gilou thupi mahmah hih ahi uh, gilkial ziak in a-omna mun ah si mai ding akei maw; khopi ah tanghou a-om nawn kei a," achi a.
english: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.

paite: Huan kumpipa'n Ethiopia mi Ebed-melek thu apia a, "Hiai a kipan in mi sawmthum pi inla, tuibem a kipan in asih ma in zawlnei Jeremiah va lakhia un," chi in.
english: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies.

paite: Huchi in Ebed-melek in mite api a, kumpipa dangka inn nuai ah alut ua, puanak lui paihte leh puansilh siate alakhia ua, tuibem ah Jeremiah kiang ah khau in akhaikhesuk uhi.
english: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took there rags and worn-out garments, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

paite: Huan Ethiopia mi Ebed-melek in Jeremiah kiang ah, "Hiai puanak luite leh puansilh siate na lenuai ah khau in gakkhum in," achi hi. Huan Jeremiah in huchibang in ahih hi.
english: Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, Put now these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the cords. Jeremiah did so.

paite: Huan Jeremiah bel tuibem a kipan khau in akaikhia ua; huchi in ngakmi huangsung ah Jeremiah a-om nilouh hi.
english: So they drew up Jeremiah with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah asam a, TOUPA' inn a lutna thumna ah akiang ah apilut a; huan, kumpipa'n Jeremiah kiang ah, "Thil ka hon dong ding; ka lak ah bangmah iim nei ke'n," achi hi.
heading: Zedekiah In Jeremiah Thuhilhna Angen
english: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet to him into the third entry that is in the house of Yahweh: and the king said to Jeremiah, I will ask you something. Hide nothing from me.

paite: Jeremiah in Zedekiah kiang ah, "Hon hilh leng na hon that mahmah kei dia hia? Thu hon hanthawn leng lah hon ngaikhe lou ding chin a,” achi hi.
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, If I declare it to you, will you not surely put me to death? and if I give you counsel, you will not listen to me.

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang ah, "TOUPA hiai ka hinna bawlpa ahin a ahin sung teng ka hon hihlum kei hial ding, na hinna zong mite khut ah leng nang ka hon pe sam kei ding," chi in asim in akichiam hi.
english: So Zedekiah the king swore secretly to Jeremiah, saying, As Yahweh lives, who made us this soul, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men who seek your life.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in Zedekiah kiang ah, "TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Babilon kumpipa heutute kiang ah na kipiak leh na hinna na bitsak ding a, hiai khopi leng mei in akang kei ding, nang leh na inkote leng na hing ding uh.'
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, Thus says Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: If you will go forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, then your soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and you shall live, and your house.

paite: Babulon kumpipa heutute kiang a na kipiak keileh bel hiai khopi Kaldaite khut a piak ahi ding a, ahal ding ua, akhut ua kipan na suakta het kei ding achi," achi hi.
english: But if you will not go forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and you shall not escape out of their hand.

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang ah, "Kaldai mite kiang a kipia Judate khut ah ahon mansak in nuihzat in ahon bawl kha ding uh ka lau hi,” achi hi.
english: Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews who are fallen away to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.

paite: Jeremiah in bel, “Ahon mansak kei ding uh; na kiang a ka gen TOUPA aw mang mai in. Huchi in nang a ding in ahoih ding a, hin leng na hing ding. 21 Kipiak na ut keileh bel TOUPA'N hon thu kawkmuh hiai ahi:
english: But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver you. Obey, I beg you, the voice of Yahweh, in that which I speak to you: so it shall be well with you, and your soul shall live.

paite: Kipiak na ut keileh bel TOUPA'N hon thu kawkmuh hiai ahi:
english: But if you refuse to go forth, this is the word that Yahweh has shown me:

paite: "Ngai in, Judah kumpipa' inn a numei omlaite tengteng Babulon kumpipa heutute kiang ah pi in a-om ding ua, huai numeite'n, na lawm hoihhoihte'n ahon khem ua, ahon zouta ua, na khe buannawi a atumtak in ahon lehngatsan ua," achi ding uhi.
english: behold, all the women who are left in the king of Judah’s house shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those women shall say, Your familiar friends have set you on, and have prevailed over you. Your feet are sunk in the mire, they have turned away back.

paite: "Na zite, na tanute Kaldai mite kiang ah api vek ding ua, akhut ua kipan na suakta kei ding a, Babulon kumpipa khut ah mat in na om zaw ding a, nang ziak in hiai khopi akang ding," achi hi.
english: They shall bring out all your wives and your children to the Chaldeans; and you shall not escape out of their hand, but shall be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and you shall cause this city to be burned with fire.

paite: Huan Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang ah, "Hiai thute kuamah in thei kei uhen, huchi in na si kei ding.
english: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and you shall not die.

paite: Himahleh heutute'n ka hon houpih azak ua, na kiang a ahong ua, na kiang a, 'Kumpipa kiang a na gen hon hilh in; ka lak uah bangmah iim nei ke'nla, ka hon that kei ding uh; na kiang a kumpipa thugente leng, achih uleh,
english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you, and tell you, Declare to us now what you have said to the king; don’t hide it from us, and we will not put you to death; also what the king said to you:

paite: nang akiang uah, 'Jonathan inn a hon kiksak lou a, huai a va si lou ding in kumpipa kiang ah ngetna ka pelut lel ahi, na chi ding hi,' "achi hi.
english: then you shall tell them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.

paite: Jeremiah kiang ah heutu tengteng hong pai in, adongta ngei ua, kumpipa'n thu apiak tengteng bang in amau ahilh hi. Huchi in akihoupih uh atawp ua; athu theih phak ahita kei hi.
english: Then came all the princes to Jeremiah, and asked him; and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah bel Jerusalem lak ni tan in ngakmi huangsung ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.
